title: POC Weekly: Onboard Risk & Fallback Sync
meeting_header: Date: 2026-04-14 | Start: 15:00 UTC | Duration: 44m | Attendees: Maya Chen (Redwood AE), Liam O'Connor (Redwood SE), Priya Rao, Ethan Morales, Leila Barnes, Jasmine Cole
summary: Weekly POC checkpoint focused on environment readiness, access handoffs, risk/fallback playbooks for inference outages, and next steps for security review and a latency rerun. Agreed on two short tests: hosted fallback validation and KMS key exchange. Action items assigned for creds and bench schedule.
topics: Access status: staging creds + VPC peering
Fallback plan: hosted API vs dedicated pool failover
Performance retest: KV cache warm-up and latency window
Timeline: readiness gates and sign-off criteria
transcript:
[00:00] Maya Chen: Hey everyone, thanks for joining, um, this is Maya from Redwood. Quick roll call?
[00:10] Priya Rao: Hi, Priya here.
[00:12] Ethan Morales: Ethan -- Platform.
[00:13] Leila Barnes: Leila, Security.
[00:15] Jasmine Cole: Jasmine, product.
[00:20] Liam O'Connor: Liam, engineering at Redwood. I'll cover the bench details.
[02:05] Maya Chen: High-level agenda, we want to cover access state, any blockers, the fallback test plan we proposed last week, and security handoff. Priya, do you want to start with access?
[02:23] Priya Rao: Sure. We got the staging creds on Monday, um, but there was an issue with VPC peering, the route table wasn't propagating to the inference subnet — so the egress to Redwood gateway failed intermittently. Ethan has a ticket in with infra. We've also asked for the KMS key policy; Leila will follow up.
[02:55] Ethan Morales: Yeah, route added but propagation delay, should clear in 24 hours, we have a rollback plan. We tested a curl to the gateway; sometimes it 504s which looks like NAT timeout, not Redwood side.
[03:25] Leila Barnes: From security, KMS policy needs to include the Redwood service principal; we can't share keys until that's updated. Also need an audit log retention agreement for 365 days, not 90.
[04:00] Maya Chen: Got it. Liam — the fallback test we proposed, quick reminder?
[04:09] Liam O'Connor: Right, fallback test: we simulate a Dedicaed pool outage and validate automatic routing to Redwood hosted endpoint with token-level isolation. Steps: (1) flip routing policy to failover, (2) run the 2-minute throughput test, (3) validate end-to-end logs and latency. We expect a brown-increase in tail latency but no error spikes. 
[04:45] Priya Rao: Two clarifications — will the hosted fallback use the same quantization profile? Emulator? We need deterministic outputs for QA.
[04:55] Liam O'Connor: Good Q. Hosted fallback will use the same model family but may be a quantized variant; for determinism we'll pin model version and sampling seeds to minimize diffs. There will be small token-level differences but no functional regressions.
[06:10] Jasmine Cole: Is the fallback automatic or requires manual cutover? We need an ops playbook.
[06:20] Maya Chen: Auto by policy but you can set manual for the first run. We'll provide a playbook and run the first failover with you on the call.
[07:05] Ethan Morales: For the bench re-run, we also saw one big outlier at 380ms P95 which we think correlates to KV cache cold starts. Can we warm the cache?
[07:18] Liam O'Connor: Yep, KV cache warm-up is straightforward; we can send a warm-up walk of prefix traffic. Also suggest batching profile tune — reduce max tokens per batch for low-latency endpoints.
[08:45] Priya Rao: About encryption: Leila, you said we can't share keys yet — how long to update the policy?
[08:55] Leila Barnes: We can update the KMS policy today if the Redwood service principal info is final. I need the principal string and an engineer to confirm TLS mutual auth details.
[09:30] Maya Chen: I'll send the principal string in chat after the call.
[10:05] Liam O'Connor: On telemetry — endpoint logs will show request id mapping, we record model variant, quant profile, and tokens used. For the fallback run we'll flag requests so you can filter them.
[12:00] Priya Rao: Ok. On success criteria — we define a gate: <= 3% error rate during failover window, P95 latency < 700ms for targeted prompt mix, and agreement on acceptable output drift threshold. Jasmine to own output regression acceptance.
[13:10] Jasmine Cole: Yes, we'll run a small prompt set (100 prompts) and compare. If drift over 4% we hold.
[15:05] Maya Chen: Great. Let's talk schedule — we propose failover test Thursday 2026-04-16 16:00 UTC, bench retest Friday 2026-04-17 morning. Are those okay?
[15:23] Ethan Morales: Thursday works for us, engineer availability confirmed.
[15:30] Leila Barnes: I'll allocate security time Friday afternoon to review logs.
[16:00] Liam O'Connor: On the bench itself — we'll instrument three scenarios: warm KV (steady state), cold KV (fresh boot), and hosted fallback. Each run 10k requests distributed across prompt lengths. Expect results in 3 hours after run.
[18:50] Priya Rao: Quick question on credentials: do we need new API keys for the fallback smoke test or reuse staging keys?
[19:00] Maya Chen: Use staging keys but scoped tokens will reflect fallback routing. We'll document.
[20:15] Ethan Morales: About audit logs retention — we had asked for 365 days; is that included for Private deployments?
[20:28] Maya Chen: For Private we can support 365 days; for Hosted we have configurable retention add-ons. We'll share the pricing table.
[22:10] Leila Barnes: Also SSO — we did a SAML test last week but the assertion mapping needs the email attribute name mapping fixed.
[22:30] Liam O'Connor: We'll queue that with our SSO specialist, should be a 1-hour change.
[25:05] Jasmine Cole: Any blockers for start-of-test?
[25:12] Ethan Morales: Main blocker is KMS principal and VPC propagation.
[25:30] Priya Rao: And final approval on the regression prompt set. We'll send that by EOD.
[26:02] Maya Chen: Action: Maya to send Redwood principal and playbook link; Priya to send prompt set; Liam to prepare bench script and fallback flagging.
[28:40] Liam O'Connor: Noted. Also, we recommend running a short synthetic load for 5 minutes before the official run to warm any autoscaling paths.
[30:00] Priya Rao: Good call.
[31:10] Leila Barnes: Security question — can we get a sample audit log showing request-id mapping and KMS key usage?
[31:25] Liam O'Connor: Yes, we'll grab a redacted sample and push to the shared folder.
[33:00] Jasmine Cole: One more: if fallback shows degraded quality beyond threshold, what's the rollback? Manual route back?
[33:12] Maya Chen: If we cross drift threshold, we trigger an immediate rollback policy and open a triage ticket; Redwood will provide root-cause assist. We'll also record a detailed diff report.
[35:40] Ethan Morales: Are there any competitors we should be wary of if we need alternative hosting? We briefly looked at Anthropic and self-hosting options.
[35:52] Maya Chen: Noted. We have customers who choose hosted fallback or keep a small dedicated reserve. We'll send a short comparative note.
[37:00] Priya Rao: Ok let's recap actions and owners.
[37:15] Maya Chen: Recap now.
[37:20] Liam O'Connor: For bench: Liam will run Thursday failover, Friday retest, will share raw CSV.
[37:32] Priya Rao: Priya will send regression prompt set by EOD.
[37:38] Leila Barnes: Leila will update KMS policy and confirm audit retention by Friday.
[37:45] Ethan Morales: Ethan to verify VPC propagation and notify when route table is stable.
[38:00] Jasmine Cole: Jasmine will approve or flag the prompt set within 24 hours.
[38:20] Maya Chen: I'll send the operational playbook, Redwood principal string, and playbook link immediately after the call and the SOC2 pack by tomorrow AM.
[40:00] Priya Rao: Thanks everyone.
[40:05] Maya Chen: Thanks, we'll follow up in the thread and see you on Thursday.
[40:10] (meeting ends)
action_items: Maya Chen - Send Redwood service principal string and operational playbook link - due 2026-04-14
Priya Rao - Share regression prompt set (100 prompts) for drift acceptance - due 2026-04-14 EOD
Liam O'Connor - Prepare bench scripts, flags for fallback, run Thursday failover and Friday full retest, upload raw results - due 2026-04-18
Leila Barnes - Update KMS policy to include Redwood principal and confirm audit retention 365d - due 2026-04-17
Ethan Morales - Confirm VPC route propagation and NAT timeout fix, mark as resolved in ticket - due 2026-04-15
Jasmine Cole - Review prompt set and approve or flag regressions within 24h - due 2026-04-15

Bench retest Friday 2026-04-17 morning — warm KV, cold KV, hosted fallback
